crossRefs.note: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am…
The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the…
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…

translations.web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
translations.bsb: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
translations.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
translations.asv: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.
